hits.name: Chubby♨️
hits.hook: Seriously mindblowing: This voice model runs locally on an M4 Max Mac or better. Feels like magic.
hits.draft_en:
A voice model running fully on-device on a high-end Mac is a bigger deal than it sounds.

Why local voice matters:
• Latency: no round trip
• Privacy: audio never leaves the machine
• Cost: zero per-minute fees

If cloud voice agents get beaten by a laptop, the moat moves from model access to product design.

Would you trust a local-only voice assistant?
hits.video_tip: Screen-capture a live local voice demo with airplane mode on (Wi-Fi icon visible, crossed out). Caption: 'No internet. Still talking.' 10-20s, raw audio.

hits.hook: Spent a lot of time on this today. I confirmed it's a real bug on Anthropic's side. To be clear: this does not affect weekly limits. All Agents SDK usage will drain your 5h limits faster than using Claude Code directly.
hits.draft_en:
AI coding in 2026 isn't a model race. It's a quota race.

A dev just documented that Agents SDK usage drains 5-hour limits faster than using Claude Code directly (weekly limits unaffected, reported to Anthropic).

Before you pick a model, check:
1. Which surface you call it from
2. How limits are metered
3. What happens at the cap

Cheapest token ≠ cheapest workflow.
hits.video_tip: 15s screen recording of a usage/limit meter filling up in two tabs side by side (SDK vs CLI). Overlay captions '5h limit' and 'same task, different drain'.

hits.draft_en:
Consumer AI agents are splitting into two camps:

1. Chat apps you open
2. Always-on agents that act (apps on your phone, vaults for logins, calling on your behalf)

If you're about to hand any agent your logins, check 3 things:
• Per-app Allow buttons, not one big switch
• What's stored in the vault, and who can see it
• How to revoke in one tap

What would you let an agent do?
hits.video_tip: Phone screen-record of an agent permission screen with per-app Allow toggles being tapped one by one; zoom into the 'revoke' option for the last 3 seconds.
